description: MainActivity.java defines the main activity for an Android application that manages device and application restrictions, including profile setup, app visibility, and UI fragment management.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling device profile setup, app status checks, and fragment navigation in the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks profile and app installation status, and decides which UI fragment to display.

methods.name: showSetupProfile
methods.description: Displays the setup profile fragment for initial configuration.

methods.name: showStatusProfile
methods.description: Displays the status fragment to show app or profile status.

methods.name: showMainFragment
methods.description: Displays the main app restriction enforcement fragment.

methods.name: onStatusUpdated
methods.description: Callback that shows the main fragment when the status updates.
